locations.name: Village Square
locations.description: Dusk. Tables are still set. No one is here.

locations.name: Keeper's House
locations.description: Swept floors. A chair stands empty at the head of the table.

locations.name: Row of Houses
locations.description: Doors left open. Shoes by every step. Each house waits for someone.

locations.name: Fields
locations.description: Straw figures lean over a harvest no one came for.

locations.name: Tool Shed
locations.description: Rakes and hoes hang in rows. Some of them have climbed down.

locations.name: Scarecrow Hill
locations.description: One scarecrow stands taller than the rest. Roots have grown through it.

locations.name: Riverbank
locations.description: The river moves. Nothing else does.

locations.name: Schoolhouse
locations.description: Books lie open on every desk.

locations.name: Village Gate
locations.description: The road ends here. The gate is shut. Something small is scratched into the wood, pale against the grain: an empty chair.
